title: FYI Yachts Secures Exclusive 5.99% Fixed-Rate Financing
description: Limited-time FYI Yachts offer: secure 20-year fixed-rate yacht financing at 5.99%—available for new builds and brokerage vessels worldwide.
html:
A Paradigm Shift in Marine Finance: Secure Your Asset with a 20-Year Fixed Rate

Florida Yachts International (FYI) is pleased to announce a premier financing opportunity designed for our most discerning clients. For a limited time, FYI Yachts has secured a fixed-rate financing facility at 5.99% interest for a 20-year term.

This exclusive program is available across our entire global inventory, including new builds and world-class brokerage vessels.

2017 Azimut 30 Metri Raised PilotHouse – $5,295,000

The Strategy of Leverage

For the ultra-high-net-worth buyer, the decision to finance is rarely about the monthly payment—it is about the opportunity cost of capital. By locking in a sub-6% rate for two decades, owners can preserve their liquid reserves for high-performance investments while enjoying immediate access to the yachting lifestyle.

In a shifting financial landscape, this 20-year fixed term offers a rare hedge against volatility, providing a predictable, low-cost capital structure that complements a sophisticated wealth management strategy.

2012 Azimut Grande 105 – $5,275,000

Why Now? A Limited Window of Opportunity

This financing initiative is a strictly limited-time offer. As the marine lending market continues to tighten its underwriting criteria, FYI Yachts has utilized its 30-year industry standing to bridge the gap for our clients.

  • Universal Eligibility: Applicable to all models and manufacturers within the FYI portfolio.
  • Long-Term Stability: A rare 20-year amortization schedule to maximize cash flow.
  • Bespoke Execution: Our specialists provide a white-glove, discreet application process tailored to complex financial profiles.
2026 Posillipo Technema 90 – $9,180,000

Experience the FYI Advantage

Whether you are considering a custom Sunseeker for the Mediterranean or a late-model Azimut for the Florida keys, our team ensures your acquisition is as seamless as the voyage itself. This is not merely a loan; it is an invitation to leverage our expertise to your advantage.

Consult with an FYI Specialist Given the exclusive nature of this rate, we encourage interested parties to contact our Miami headquarters immediately.
